message:
fix: restore about:blank cloak (URL hidden); keep popup focused

Re-open the cloak popup as an opaque about:blank host so the site URL
never appears in the address bar. The popup is re-focused at 350ms/1.2s/
3s/6s so ChromeOS's freezer/memory-saver treats it as the active tab
instead of reclaiming it as a background about:blank shell.

fix: run cloak popup as a real tab instead of about:blank+document.write

The cloak opened a fresh about:blank window and document.write'd an iframe
host, so the site ran twice (opener + popup) and the popup tab was an
opaque, history-less about:blank shell. On Chromebooks ChromeOS treats such
background popups as discardable under memory pressure and silently
whitescreens them - no crash record, matches the reported blank.

Open the popup directly at the site URL: one real tab, real origin, single
copy of the page, and it skips the cloak overlay once opened (sets the
existing 1h kw_cloak_skip). The original tab still redirects to the decoy.

perf: remove block-status indicators and their page-load probes

Every page load fired 30+ network probes (image + fetch per game/site) to
classify school hosts as blocked/unblocked, including behind the auth wall
and on the home screen. Chromebooks (especially with content-filter SSO
proxies) choke on the burst and ChromeOS blanks the tab.

Remove the block-dot indicators from game cards and site pills, drop all
scheduleBlockChecks() call sites, and delete the associated CSS. The probe
routine is now unreachable dead code and performs zero requests.

fix: cut pre-login resource spike that blanks Chromebooks

The login screen loads while the whole site (archive, shop, sites) renders
hidden behind the auth wall, and the site-wide 'block check' feature fired
12 concurrent double-probes per game/site for up to 30s on every page load.
Doubled by the cloak popup class, that spike blows past a Chromebook's
shared memory/GPU budget and ChromeOS blanks the tab.

- Only run block checks once a user is signed in (no storm behind auth).
- Re-trigger block checks right after login.
- Throttle checks to 4 concurrent, 6s probe, 12s per-URL cap.
- Cloak: location.replace for the decoy redirect so the old heavy page
  unloads immediately instead of lingering on the back-stack.

fix(Ragdoll Hit): boot under blob loading; robust progress/reveal

unity-2020.js relied on window.onload which already fired before the
blob-injected script executed, so the boot (PokiSDK init, loader fetch,
createUnityInstance) never ran. Boot immediately when the page is already
complete, pass a minimal config to createUnityInstance (full w.a config
silently stalled the loader), and make the progress/reveal callbacks
null-safe so the loader download never aborts.
